# 2 Baruch Chapter 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**25:1** And-he-answered and-said to-me: You-also will-be-kept until-that-time, [namely] until-that-sign which-the-Most-High will-perform for-the-inhabitants-of-the-earth at-the-end-of-the-days.

**25:2** This-therefore will-be the-sign: when-dread-and-confusion of-the-inhabitants-of-the-earth will-seize them, and-they-will-fall-into-many-tribulations, and-they-will-go-further into-the-great-torments.

**25:3** And-it-will-come-to-pass that-when-they-say in-their-thoughts, by-reason-of-their-many-afflictions: The-Mighty-One-does-no-more-remember the-earth — then it-will-come.

**25:4** And-at-that-time, when-the-Most-High-is-about-to-visit the-world which-he-has-made, he-will-command-a-sign to-the-peoples, and-many-tribulations will-come-upon-them.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 25 is God's brief reply describing the eschatological sign: a time of such extreme tribulation that the people will conclude God has abandoned them — at which point the end comes. This is the theological setup for the twelve woes of ch. 27.*
